lic_summary: Some mods are available only to their author's members. Sign in to the author's site once, or enter the activation code the author gave you; the license is renewed automatically before it expires.
lic_intro: Some mods are available only to their author's members. Sign in to the author's site once, or enter the activation code the author gave you; this program renews the license before it expires.
lic_other_account: The license on this computer is for another game account
lic_invalid: The license on this computer is not signed by this author's key
lic_key_changed: A mod declares a different key for this author. Check where it came from.
lic_no_account: There is no game account on this computer yet. Start the game once.
lic_test_issuer: Test build: this issuer exists only for testing, so there is nowhere to sign in. Use the author's released version.
lic_bad_declaration: This mod's license declaration (hd2_license.json) cannot be read.
lic_nothing: No mod in the library requires a license, and no author is signed in on this computer.
lic_no_mods: No mod in the library currently requires this license
lic_ask: Your browser will open {0}, the site of {1}. That site receives your game account ID ({2}).
lic_waiting: Waiting for the sign-in in your browser…
lic_page_close: You can close this page and return to the manager.
lic_sign_out_ask: Remove this author's license and sign-in from this computer? Their mods will not work until you sign in again.
lic_err_not_member: This account is not an active member, or its tier is too low.
lic_err_account_limit: This membership already has as many game accounts as the creator allows. Another can replace one some time after the last was added (the sign-in page says when); if you cannot wait, contact the creator.
lic_err_account_limit_wait: This membership already has as many game accounts as the creator allows. Another can replace one in {0} days; if you cannot wait, contact the creator.
lic_err_banned: The creator has stopped licensing this membership or game account. If you think this is a mistake, contact the creator.
lic_err_denied: Access was not granted on the author's site.
lic_err_timeout: The sign-in did not finish within 10 minutes.
lic_err_network: Could not reach the author's site (retried 3 times). Try again later, or check your network and proxy settings.
lic_err_bad_license: The license received is not signed by the key the mod declares.
lic_err_key_changed: A mod declares a different key for this author. Check where it came from.
lic_err_sign_in_again: The author's site asks you to sign in again.
lic_redeem_ask: Enter the activation code {1} gave you (XXXXX‑XXXXX‑XXXXX‑XXXXX). It is sent to {0}, which learns your game account id ({2}).
lic_err_bad_code: This is not a valid activation code. Check that it is complete and typed correctly.
lic_err_unknown_code: The author's site does not recognise this activation code. If you have just paid, try again after one minute.
lic_err_no_codes: This author does not issue activation codes. Use Sign in instead.
row_license_test_tip: This mod is a test build: its license names a test issuer, where nobody can sign in. Use the author's released version.
row_license_tip: For the author's members: sign in on the Plugins page (the jigsaw piece beside the gear).
seg_pending: {0}: the author has not yet published the member content for this version. While this program runs, it asks again every few minutes.
seg_not_signed_in: {0}: sign in to download the member content
seg_no_version: {0}: the version cannot be read from the mod's manifest.json
seg_failed: {0}: the member content could not be downloaded. {1}
seg_needs_tray: Member content is unlocked only while this program runs when the game starts. This version of HD2 Mod Quick Deploy ends when its window closes: update it to 0.22.0 or later, which keeps running in the notification area.
seg_update_manager: {0}: this mod needs a newer Member licenses plugin; update it on the Plugins page.
seg_unsealed: {0}: member content is no longer handed out for this version; update the mod to its latest version.
lic_err_bad_receipt: The content received is not signed by the key the mod declares.
lic_err_account: This game account is not bound to the membership signed in on this computer.
row_needs_window: Keep this program open when the game starts
row_unlock_late: Locked this game: the game started first
row_unlock_late_tip: This program unlocks the member content when the game starts, and this game started before it was running, so the mod does nothing in this game; it works from the next game. Open this program before the game, or turn on Start with Windows in the settings.
row_unlock_no_key: Locked last game: offline past the grace
row_unlock_no_key_tip: The key that unlocks the member content has to be renewed online now and then. At the last game start this computer had been offline longer than the grace, so the mod did nothing in that game. Go online and start the game again.
row_segments_tip: This version's member content has not been downloaded. See the Plugins page.
lic_send_log: Having a problem? Send the log to the author
lic_send_log_ask:
If signing in or downloading member content fails, you can send this computer's log to {0} ({1}) so that the author can find the cause. It records sign-ins, renewals, license checks and member content downloads, with this computer's game account ids; it contains no passwords or tokens and is kept for 30 days.

This step is not needed to get a license: signing in or entering an activation code completes that on its own.
lic_send_log_done: The log has been sent, and its reference {0} is copied to the clipboard. Include it when you describe the problem to the author, who uses it to read the log (valid for {1} days). It is not an activation code and does not grant a license.
lic_send_log_done_nocopy: The log has been sent; its reference is {0}. Include it when you describe the problem to the author, who uses it to read the log (valid for {1} days). It is not an activation code and does not grant a license.
lic_send_log_rate: The daily limit for sending logs has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
lic_send_log_no_diag: This author's site does not accept logs yet.
lic_send_log_empty: This computer has no log for this author yet.
stage_not_ready: The member content has not been unlocked yet; this is done automatically before deploying.
stage_session: This mod loads only when the game is started from the manager.
stage_no_game: The game folder has not been set.
stage_bad_package: This mod's protected files are incomplete or do not match its declaration. Download the mod again.
stage_bad_declaration: This mod's license declaration (hd2_license.json) cannot be read.
row_stage_update_manager_tip: This mod's member content needs a newer version of HD2 Mod Quick Deploy to be deployed.
